bookSourceComment:
绅士漫画（PC 模板 / 动态域名 / 登录 / 图片线路自动切换）
1. 站点按 UA 分流：本源固定使用桌面 Chrome UA（PC 模板）。没有 UA 会被 403，不要改成手机 UA。
2. 域名失效：在“登录”界面点③打开发布页、点④读取最新地址；拿到新域名后只改“源域名”（bookSourceUrl）即可整体迁移。
3. 登录：仅用于书架收藏同步；搜索、发现、详情、目录、正文均可匿名阅读。
4. 图片线路：正文自动探测 img1~5.wnimg2.cfd 并缓存；详情页简介内可固定线路/重新测速/改回自动；失败会自动重试。
5. 目录：单话本自动生成“全一話”，合集自动抓取全部章节并跳过“開始閱讀”按钮。
6. 发现：分组网格，含更新、日/周/月/年榜、全部/汉化/日语/英语/韩漫、图集与热门标签；底部“维护”可清图片线路缓存。
7. 搜索筛选：搜索框输入 `关键词|cate=9`、`关键词|tag=巨乳`、`关键词|sort=month`，支持 cate/xcate/tag/xtag/u/xu/sort，多个条件用 | 分隔。
   分类ID：1 同人誌·漢化 / 2 CG畫集 / 3 寫真Cosplay / 5 同人誌 / 6 單行本 / 7 雜誌短篇 / 9 單行本·漢化 / 10 雜誌短篇·漢化 / 12 同人誌·日語 / 13 單行本·日語 / 14 雜誌短篇·日語 / 16 同人誌·English / 17 單行本·English / 18 雜誌短篇·English / 19 韓漫 / 20 韓漫·漢化 / 21 韓漫·生肉 / 22 3D漫畫 / 37 AI圖集 / 38 韓漫·合集

Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/142.0.0.0 Safari/537.36');var r=c.getResponseCode();try{c.disconnect();}catch(e){}return r;}catch(e2){return -1;}}function wnImgSpd(){var HS=['img1.wnimg2.cfd','img2.wnimg2.cfd','img3.wnimg2.cfd','img4.wnimg2.cfd','img5.wnimg2.cfd'],rs=[],best='',bs='',i,j;for(i=0;i<HS.length;i++){var a=Date.now();if(wnUC('https://'+HS[i]+'/',6000)!=-1){rs.push(HS[i]+' https OK '+(Date.now()-a)+'ms');if(!best){best=HS[i];bs='s';}}else rs.push(HS[i]+' https X');}if(!best){for(j=0;j<HS.length;j++){if(wnUC('http://'+HS[j]+'/',6000)!=-1){best=HS[j];bs='h';rs[j]=rs[j]+' | http OK';break;}}}var NL=String.fromCharCode(10);if(best){try{source.put('imgH',best+'|'+Date.now()+'|'+bs);}catch(e){}java.longToast('📶 已选图片线路 '+best+' ('+(bs=='s'?'https':'http')+'),重进章节生效'+NL+rs.join(NL));}else{try{source.put('imgH','fail|'+Date.now());}catch(e2){}java.longToast('❌ 全部图片线路不通,需换网络或开代理'+NL+rs.join(NL));}}function wnImgClr(){try{source.put('imgH','');}catch(e){}java.toast('✔ 已清除图片线路缓存,重进章节自动重测');}

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var list = [];
var raw = String(result || src || "");
var base = String(baseUrl || "");
var mBase = base.match(/^https?:\/\/[^\/]+/i);
var domain = mBase ? mBase[0] : "";
if (!domain) {
    try {
        if (typeof source !== "undefined" && source) {
            domain = String(source.getBookSourceUrl() || "").replace(/\/+$/, "");
        }
    } catch (e) { domain = ""; }
}
var aRegex = /<a\b([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/gi;
var seen = {};
var m;
while ((m = aRegex.exec(raw)) !== null) {
    var attrs = m[1];
    if (/id="reader-btn"/i.test(attrs)) continue;
    if (/class="[^"]*dv-btn-read/i.test(attrs)) continue;
    var hrefM = attrs.match(/href="([^"]*photos-slide-aid-(\d+)[^"]*)"/i);
    if (!hrefM) continue;
    var chAid = hrefM[2];
    if (seen[chAid]) continue;
    var name = m[2].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "").replace(/ /g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, "");
    if (!name) {
        var titleM = attrs.match(/title="([^"]*)"/i);
        if (titleM) name = titleM[1].replace(/ /g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, "");
    }
    if (!name) continue;
    seen[chAid] = true;
    list.push({title: name, url: domain + "/photos-item-aid-" + chAid + ".html"});
}
if (list.length === 0) {
    var aidM = base.match(/aid-(\d+)/);
    var aid = aidM ? aidM[1] : "";
    if (!aid) {
        var ms = raw.match(/photos-(?:index|item|slide)-aid-(\d+)/);
        if (ms) aid = ms[1];
    }
    if (aid) {
        var sizeM = raw.match(/(?:頁數|章節)[：:]\s*([^<;\n]+)/);
        var size = sizeM ? ("〔" + sizeM[1].replace(/\s+/g, " ").replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, "") + "〕") : "";
        list.push({title: "全一話 " + size, url: domain + "/photos-item-aid-" + aid + ".html"});
    }
}
result = list;
result;
</js>

searchUrl:
<js>
var base = "https://www.wnacg.com/";
try {
    if (typeof baseUrl !== "undefined" && baseUrl) base = String(baseUrl);
    else if (typeof source !== "undefined" && source && typeof source.getBookSourceUrl === "function") base = String(source.getBookSourceUrl());
} catch (e) {}
base = base.replace(/\/+$/, "") + "/";
var raw = String(typeof key !== "undefined" && key ? key : "").trim();
var parts = raw.split("|");
var q = String(parts.shift() || "").trim();
var sortMap = {latest: "create_time_DESC", day: "heat_day_DESC", week: "heat_week_DESC", month: "heat_month_DESC", year: "heat_year_DESC"};
var sort = "create_time_DESC";
var extra = "";
for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
    var p = String(parts[i] || "").trim();
    if (!p) continue;
    var idx = p.indexOf("=");
    if (idx < 0) continue;
    var k = p.substring(0, idx).trim();
    var v = p.substring(idx + 1).trim();
    if (!v) continue;
    if (k === "sort") {
        sort = sortMap[v] || v;
    } else if (k === "cate" || k === "xcate" || k === "tag" || k === "xtag" || k === "u" || k === "xu") {
        extra += "&" + k + "=" + encodeURIComponent(v);
    }
}
var pg = (typeof page !== "undefined" && page) ? page : 1;
result = base + "search/?q=" + encodeURIComponent(q) + "&f=_all&syn=yes" + extra + "&s=" + encodeURIComponent(sort) + "&p=" + pg;
</js>
